title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Garden Auditorium on 1966-07-29

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of the early ’66 Dead with mind‑bending, essential performances.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, pristine sound quality—rare for a 1966 source—and delivers an essential glimpse into the band’s nascent psychedelic era. Reviewers note the music is “mind‑bending” and consider this set a go‑to document of the early Dead, despite some uncertainty about the exact setlist date.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (average 4.67 stars) and consistently highlight excellent sound quality and an essential early‑Dead performance, giving high confidence in a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, pristine sound with great clarity for a 1966 recording; reviewers describe it as ‘great quality’ and ‘pristine.’

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early setlist showcases the band’s embryonic psychedelic explorations, offering an essential snapshot of their formative sound.
